description: Get full medication details by RxCUI ID. Returns name, synonyms, term type, language, and status. Use after rxnorm_search to retrieve complete drug information.

rxcui.description: RxNorm concept ID (e.g., "7052" for metformin) OR a drug name (e.g. "aspirin", "Tylenol") — names are resolved to an RxCUI automatically.
